findings.canonical: you'll be able to name your characters. The default names are Yuri for the Rude Hero and Alice for the Girl In Danger
findings.structured: Meet the girl, confirm default character names (Yuri & Alice), and have Alice join the party
findings.issue: Canonical says the player is able to name the characters; it does not say the player confirms the default names. 'confirm' is a small wording change that implies a choice the source does not state. Preserve source wording or use 'name your characters (default: Yuri & Alice)'.

findings.location: items_summary.obtainable (Thera Seed, Mana Seed, Thera Leaf, Leather Belt, Bandanna)
findings.canonical: Push Ring: first try gives Leather Belt, second gives Thera Seed, third+ gives Thera Leaf. Normal Ring: first try gives Bandanna, second gives Mana Seed, third+ gives Mana Leaf.
findings.structured: Thera Seed location: 'Chest below bridge (Southern gate handle retrieved on 2nd try)'; Mana Seed location: 'Chest below bridge (Northern gate handle retrieved on 2nd try)'; Leather Belt and Bandanna list only the bridge chest
findings.issue: The obtainable summary lists only the bridge chest as a location for these items, while the same items are also awarded by the sluice gate mini-game (step 7). The step-level data is correct, but the summary is incomplete for these items.

findings.canonical: It shows you how many points away you are from leveling up a class.
findings.structured: displaying points required to level up each fusion element class
findings.issue: 'fusion element class' is a slight rewording that adds terminology not in the source. Source says 'a class'. Low severity; no fact changed.

findings.canonical: NOTE: To sum up everything that the Masks have said ... Right now, you WILL die if you try to fight him ...

findings.issue: The callout repeats the same Masks summary already shown in step 11 notes ('What the Masks said'). Duplicated text is a presentation issue, not a fact change. Consider keeping one copy.
